selection.size_measure: Total proposed homes in each application, across all its phases. Counts do not imply homes are completed or currently for sale.
selection.coverage: Five of the largest verified residential proposals in the non-closed application snapshot; reviewed descriptions and City reports, including Georgetown whose GIS description omits its unit total. Not a guaranteed exhaustive citywide ranking.
selection.excluded: 24-0286-00 Gateway is Concluded in current City GIS. Georgetown West uses 2,079 homes in the September 2025 report, replacing an older 2,208 count.
selection.geometry: Official application site outlines for all five additions. Bristol Estates, Regency Gardens and Georgetown West now have approximate source-plan massing, with per-component provenance. The two Guildford projects retain outlines only because suitable plans and complete building heights have not been verified.
